I replied to Ilse in our DM. I told them the possible Bay 35 move for the Tansley Parcel depot stays in that DM and won't go to any channel or anyone else.

I didn't save the rumour anywhere, not in GBrain and not in my own memory, so it can't come up in someone else's conversation later. I searched GBrain for "Tansley Parcel" before replying. It only found an old Central territory plan from 2025, which has nothing on the depot move, so there was nothing to follow up on.
